summary: Anthropic closed its Nasdaq debut at $97.17 on Nov 19, +17% over the $83 IPO price (dealroom relay and briefing), which marks up Alphabet's stake. If the research carries the stake at the IPO price, the lift is roughly +$1.1 a share (about +0.4% before the tax and overlay already in the set); a screen only. A dealroom relay puts Google at 13.7% of outstanding stock versus the research's 7.36% at the IPO, which is unverified and conflicts. Also a 424B5 prospectus supplement filed Nov 19 (contents not read) and a law-firm notice on the 2026 Gemini class action.

items.headline: Anthropic closes first day at $97.17, +17% vs $83 IPO; Amazon and Google said to hold about 14.7% and 13.7%
items.why: Stake mark-up is a non-operating item the engine already sizes (S-1 cap table 7.36% at IPO); the 13.7% share figure conflicts and is unverified. Arithmetic: 17% x $81.2B carry = $13.8B / 12.44B shares = $1.11, vs $294.56 = +0.38%.
